sentences.en: The phenomena of rapid multipoint autoignition were observed in the experiment of diesel fuel spray issuing into the CATA, and a special lifted flame appeared with a triple flame.

sentences.en: Then, different mixing types are tested for autoignition. The results of injector head type has better performance and avoids higher temperature area producing in the wall.

sentences.en: The ignition process of the PCCI combustion was a separated volume autoignition process, which was strongly influenced by the condition of fuel stratification.
